meta.title: Capabilities — ACC & Associates
meta.description: Nine service lines. One accountable practice. Feasibility, cost review, PERT planning, construction management, contract administration, tendering, risk, defects and independent advisory.

intro.headline: Nine service lines. One accountable practice.
intro.lede: From feasibility through completion, dispute and independent review — commercially aware, evidence-controlled, aligned with NSW obligations.

items.name: Development & Project Feasibility
items.what: Preliminary project feasibility, scope definition, construction methodology review, preliminary cost planning, program assessment, risk identification, procurement strategy and project viability advice.
items.when: You are about to seek finance, land at auction, or trigger a stage-two commitment, and the numbers in front of you have not yet been independently tested.
items.deliverable: Written feasibility report, cost plan, risk register, and a board or lender presentation.

items.name: Construction Cost & Pricing Review
items.what: Review of cost structures, direct costs, subcontractor allowances, preliminaries, overheads, contingencies, risk allowances and margins. Tender review, price reasonableness, scope gaps and commercial exposure.
items.when: You need a cost check that is not the builder's, and not a headline number from a spreadsheet you cannot audit.
items.deliverable: Priced review with rate build-ups, assumptions register, and written commentary on the drivers of the number.

items.name: Project Planning & PERT / Program Management
items.trigger: Programme that survives contact with the site.
items.what: Development of project timelines, WBS, activity sequencing, dependencies, PERT estimates, critical path analysis, float analysis, milestones, procurement interfaces and recovery strategies.
items.when: You need a programme that can be defended, updated on evidence, and used to run the job.
items.deliverable: Baseline programme, WBS, updated programme cycles, and monthly float and critical-path commentary.

items.name: Construction Management & Site Coordination
items.what: Practical support for construction planning, site coordination, subcontractor interfaces, sequencing, progress monitoring, quality coordination, inspections, defects management and completion.
items.when: You want an experienced construction hand on your side of the fence during delivery.
items.deliverable: Weekly site reports, subcontractor interface register, defects tracking, and monthly principal reports.

items.name: Contract Administration & Commercial Support
items.what: Contract documentation, progress claims, variations, payment assessment support, notices, program interfaces, records, correspondence and commercial tracking — subject to contractual requirements.
items.when: You are the principal or superintendent and need the paperwork run by a firm that knows both sides of the same disputes.
items.deliverable: Live registers, monthly reporting, and a complete document register at practical completion.

items.name: Tendering & Procurement Advisory
items.trigger: Get the right builder onto the right contract.
items.what: Tender preparation & review, scope packaging, subcontractor procurement, tender comparisons, clarifications, procurement schedules, long-lead item identification and capability review.
items.when: You want the tender run to a standard that can be defended later if the award is questioned.
items.deliverable: Tender package, tenderer register, scored evaluation and a recommendation memo to the principal.

items.name: Risk, Compliance & Project Controls
items.what: Construction, commercial, program, procurement and delivery risks. We assist clients establish registers, reporting, inspection records, document controls and escalation aligned with NSW obligations.
items.when: You want an independent set of eyes on quality, risk and compliance — separate from the builder's own QA.
items.deliverable: Live risk register, controls matrix, audit reports and non-conformance summaries with actions.

items.name: Defects, Completion & Handover
items.what: Completion planning, defect identification and tracking, close-out coordination, documentation review, handover planning and assistance with final project records.
items.when: You are approaching practical completion and need someone to marshal the paperwork and the punch list.
items.deliverable: Defect register, close-out pack, PC certificate support and DLP handover plan.

items.name: Independent Construction Advisory
items.trigger: A second read from someone without a stake.
items.what: Independent review of project status, construction methodology, program performance, cost exposure, documentation and delivery risks so owners and stakeholders can decide with clarity.
items.when: You need a defensible independent read — for a board, a lender, an insurer, or a court.
items.deliverable: Written independent report with findings, recommended actions and a Q&A session with your team.
